title: Grammar of the Shan Language (2nd Expanded Edition)
author: Rev. Josiah Nelson Cushing
description: The landmark 1887 expanded second edition of Josiah Nelson Cushing's authoritative grammar of the Shan (Tai Yai) language. It provides an exhaustive analysis of Tai phonology, tones, compounding, inflectional absence, modal auxiliaries, and syntactic paradigms directly ancestral and cognate to Tai Khamyang in Upper Assam.
source: Rangoon: American Baptist Mission Press, Archive ID: cushing-1887-grammar-shan-language-jk-modified-sep-24
